title: {{APP_TITLE}}: problem triage
description: SCAFFOLD. When Davis opens a problem, gathers the evidence the Insights app shows (error logs in the app boundary) and sends a plain-language summary to the owning team. Not deployed by default.

eventTrigger.filterQuery: event.kind == "DAVIS_PROBLEM" AND event.status == "ACTIVE" AND matchesValue(event.status_transition, {"CREATED", "REOPENED"}) AND matchesValue(event.category, {"AVAILABILITY", "ERROR", "SLOWDOWN", "RESOURCE_CONTENTION"})

evidence.name: evidence
evidence.description: Containers in the app boundary with errors right now

input.query:
fetch logs, from:now()-30m
| filter k8s.namespace.name=="{{NAMESPACE}}" and (loglevel=="ERROR" or loglevel=="WARN")
| summarize errors=count(), sample=takeFirst(content), by:{container=k8s.container.name}
| sort errors desc | limit 10

summarise.name: summarise
summarise.description: Builds the plain-language summary. TODO: link to the Insights app with ?ns= and the affected service.

notify.name: notify
notify.description: TODO: set recipients (or replace with Slack / ServiceNow / Jira). Disabled in the scaffold.
